verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron in the land of Egypt . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés e a Arão na terra do Egito:

verses.original: הַחֹ֧דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם רֹ֣אשׁ חֳדָשִׁ֑ים רִאשׁ֥וֹן הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם לְחָדְשֵׁ֖י הַשָּׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥō·ḏeš haz·zeh lā·ḵem rōš ḥo·ḏā·šîm ri·šō·wn hū lā·ḵem lə·ḥā·ḏə·šê haš·šā·nāh
verses.literal: This month is the beginning of months for you it shall be the first month of your year
verses.literalPt: Este mês será para vós o princípio dos meses; este vos será o primeiro dos meses do ano.

verses.original: דַּבְּר֗וּ אֶֽל־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בֶּעָשֹׂ֖ר לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וְיִקְח֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם אִ֛ישׁ שֶׂ֥ה לְבֵית־ אָבֹ֖ת שֶׂ֥ה לַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bə·rū ’el- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr be·‘ā·śōr la·ḥō·ḏeš haz·zeh wə·yiq·ḥū lā·hem ’îš śeh lə·ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇōṯ śeh lab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: Tell . . . the whole congregation of Israel . . . that on the tenth day of this month each man must select a lamb for his family . . . one per household
verses.literalPt: Falai a toda a congregação de Israel: Ao décimo dia deste mês, tomarão para si um cordeiro cada um, segundo as casas de seus pais, um cordeiro para cada família.

verses.original: וְאִם־ יִמְעַ֣ט הַבַּיִת֮ מִהְיֹ֣ת מִשֶּׂה֒ וְלָקַ֣ח ה֗וּא וּשְׁכֵנ֛וֹ הַקָּרֹ֥ב אֶל־ בֵּית֖וֹ בְּמִכְסַ֣ת נְפָשֹׁ֑ת אִ֚ישׁ לְפִ֣י אָכְל֔וֹ תָּכֹ֖סּוּ עַל־ הַשֶּֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yim·‘aṭ hab·ba·yiṯ mih·yōṯ miś·śeh wə·lā·qaḥ hū ū·šə·ḵê·nōw haq·qā·rōḇ ’el- bê·ṯōw bə·miḵ·saṯ nə·p̄ā·šōṯ ’îš lə·p̄î ’ā·ḵə·lōw tā·ḵōs·sū ‘al- haś·śeh
verses.literal: If the household . . . is too small for a whole lamb they are to share with the nearest neighbor . . . . . . based on the number of people and apportion . . . the lamb accordingly
verses.literalPt: Se a família for pequena demais para um cordeiro, então, o tomará ele e o seu vizinho mais próximo segundo o número das almas; conforme o comer de cada um, calculareis quantos bastem para o cordeiro.

verses.original: שֶׂ֥ה תָמִ֛ים זָכָ֥ר בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם מִן־ הַכְּבָשִׂ֥ים וּמִן־ הָעִזִּ֖ים תִּקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: śeh ṯā·mîm zā·ḵār ben- šā·nāh yih·yeh lā·ḵem min- hak·kə·ḇā·śîm ū·min- hā·‘iz·zîm tiq·qā·ḥū
verses.literal: Your lamb must be an unblemished year-old . . . male and you may take it from the sheep . . . or the goats
verses.literalPt: O cordeiro ou o cabrito será sem defeito, macho de um ano; haveis de tomá-lo das ovelhas ou das cabras;

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה לָכֶם֙ לְמִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת עַ֣ד אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וְשָׁחֲט֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ כֹּ֛ל קְהַ֥ל עֲדַֽת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lā·ḵem lə·miš·me·reṯ ‘aḏ ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš haz·zeh wə·šā·ḥă·ṭū ’ō·ṯōw kōl qə·hal ‘ă·ḏaṯ- yiś·rā·’êl bên hā·‘ar·bā·yim
verses.literal: You must keep it until the fourteenth . . . day of the month when the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel will slaughter the animals at twilight
verses.literalPt: e o guardareis até o décimo quarto dia deste mês. Toda a assembleia da congregação de Israel o matará à tardinha.

verses.original: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ מִן־ הַדָּ֔ם וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֥י הַמְּזוּזֹ֖ת וְעַל־ הַמַּשְׁק֑וֹף עַ֚ל הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ יֹאכְל֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qə·ḥū min- had·dām wə·nā·ṯə·nū ‘al- šə·tê ham·mə·zū·zōṯ wə·‘al- ham·maš·qō·wp̄ ‘al hab·bāt·tîm ’ă·šer- yō·ḵə·lū ’ō·ṯōw bā·hem
verses.literal: They are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs
verses.literalPt: Tomarão do sangue e pô-lo-ão sobre as duas ombreiras e sobre a verga das portas, nas casas em que o comerão.

verses.original: וְאָכְל֥וּ אֶת־ הַבָּשָׂ֖ר בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַזֶּ֑ה צְלִי־ אֵ֣שׁ וּמַצּ֔וֹת עַל־ מְרֹרִ֖ים יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- hab·bā·śār bal·lay·lāh haz·zeh ṣə·lî- ’êš ū·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ‘al- mə·rō·rîm yō·ḵə·lu·hū
verses.literal: They are to eat the meat that night roasted over the fire along with unleavened bread . . . and bitter herbs
verses.literalPt: Naquela noite comerão a carne assada no fogo e pães asmos; com ervas amargas o comerão.

verses.original: אַל־ תֹּאכְל֤וּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ נָ֔א וּבָשֵׁ֥ל מְבֻשָּׁ֖ל בַּמָּ֑יִם כִּ֣י אִם־ צְלִי־ אֵ֔שׁ רֹאשׁ֥וֹ עַל־ כְּרָעָ֖יו וְעַל־ קִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·ḵə·lū mim·men·nū nā ū·ḇā·šêl mə·ḇuš·šāl bam·mā·yim kî ’im- ṣə·lî- ’êš rō·šōw ‘al- kə·rā·‘āw wə·‘al- qir·bōw
verses.literal: Do not eat any of the meat raw or cooked in boiling water but only . . . roasted over the fire its head and legs . . . and inner parts
verses.literalPt: Não comereis dele cru, nem cozido em água, senão assado no fogo; comereis a sua cabeça com as suas pernas e com a sua fressura.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־ בֹּ֑קֶר וְהַנֹּתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֛נּוּ עַד־ בֹּ֖קֶר בָּאֵ֥שׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯō·w·ṯî·rū mim·men·nū ‘aḏ- bō·qer wə·han·nō·ṯār mim·men·nū ‘aḏ- bō·qer bā·’êš tiś·rō·p̄ū
verses.literal: Do not leave any of it until morning before the morning you must burn up . . . any part that is left over
verses.literalPt: Nada deixareis dele até pela manhã; porém o que dele ficar até pela manhã, queimá-lo-eis no fogo.

verses.original: וְכָכָה֮ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹתוֹ֒ מָתְנֵיכֶ֣ם חֲגֻרִ֔ים נַֽעֲלֵיכֶם֙ בְּרַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם וּמַקֶּלְכֶ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶ֑ם וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ בְּחִפָּז֔וֹן פֶּ֥סַח ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·ḵāh tō·ḵə·lū ’ō·ṯōw mā·ṯə·nê·ḵem ḥă·ḡu·rîm na·‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·raḡ·lê·ḵem ū·maq·qel·ḵem bə·yeḏ·ḵem wa·’ă·ḵal·tem ’ō·ṯōw bə·ḥip·pā·zō·wn pe·saḥ hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is how you are to eat it You must be fully dressed for travel . . . with your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand You are to eat in haste it is the LORD’s Passover
verses.literalPt: Desta maneira o comereis: tendo os vossos lombos cingidos, os vossos sapatos nos pés e o vosso cajado nas mãos; comê-la-eis à pressa. É a Páscoa de Jeová.

verses.original: וְעָבַרְתִּ֣י בְאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַיִם֮ בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַזֶּה֒ וְהִכֵּיתִ֤י כָל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵאָדָ֖ם וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה וּבְכָל־ אֱלֹהֵ֥י מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה שְׁפָטִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar·tî ḇə·’e·reṣ- miṣ·ra·yim bal·lay·lāh haz·zeh wə·hik·kê·ṯî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mê·’ā·ḏām wə·‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh ū·ḇə·ḵāl ’ĕ·lō·hê miṣ·ra·yim ’e·‘ĕ·śeh šə·p̄ā·ṭîm ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: On that night I will pass through the land of Egypt and strike down every firstborn male - both man and beast and I will execute judgment against all the gods of Egypt I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porque naquela noite passarei pela terra do Egito e ferirei na terra do Egito todos os primogênitos, tanto homens como animais; sobre todos os deuses do Egito executarei juízos; eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ הַדָּ֨ם לָכֶ֜ם לְאֹ֗ת עַ֤ל הַבָּתִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם שָׁ֔ם וְרָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ הַדָּ֔ם וּפָסַחְתִּ֖י עֲלֵכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה בָכֶ֥ם נֶ֙גֶף֙ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית בְּהַכֹּתִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh had·dām lā·ḵem lə·’ōṯ ‘al hab·bāt·tîm ’ă·šer ’at·tem šām wə·rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- had·dām ū·p̄ā·saḥ·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·lō- yih·yeh ḇā·ḵem ne·ḡep̄ lə·maš·ḥîṯ bə·hak·kō·ṯî bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: The blood on the houses where you are staying will be a sign when I see the blood I will pass over you No plague will fall on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: O sangue vos será por sinal nas casas em que estiverdes; quando eu vir o sangue, passarei por vós, e não haverá entre vós praga para vos destruir, quando eu ferir a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ הַיּ֨וֹם הַזֶּ֤ה לָכֶם֙ לְזִכָּר֔וֹן וְחַגֹּתֶ֥ם אֹת֖וֹ חַ֣ג לַֽיהוָ֑ה לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תְּחָגֻּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh hay·yō·wm haz·zeh lā·ḵem lə·zik·kā·rō·wn wə·ḥag·gō·ṯem ’ō·ṯōw ḥaḡ Yah·weh lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām tə·ḥāg·gu·hū
verses.literal: And this day will be a memorial for you and you are to celebrate it as a feast to the LORD as a permanent statute for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: Este dia vos será por memorial, e o celebrareis como uma festa por estatuto perpétuo.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ מַצּ֣וֹת תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ אַ֚ךְ בַּיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן תַּשְׁבִּ֥יתוּ שְּׂאֹ֖ר מִבָּתֵּיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י׀ כָּל־ אֹכֵ֣ל חָמֵ֗ץ וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה הַנֶּ֤פֶשׁ הַהִוא֙ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשֹׁ֖ן עַד־ י֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm maṣ·ṣō·wṯ tō·ḵê·lū ’aḵ bay·yō·wm hā·ri·šō·wn taš·bî·ṯū śə·’ōr mib·bāt·tê·ḵem kî kāl- ’ō·ḵêl ḥā·mêṣ wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mî·yiś·rā·’êl mî·yō·wm hā·ri·šōn ‘aḏ- yō·wm haš·šə·ḇi·‘î
verses.literal: For seven days you must eat . . . unleavened bread On the first day you are to remove the leaven from your houses . . . Whoever eats anything leavened from the first day through the seventh . . . must be cut off . . . . . . from Israel
verses.literalPt: Sete dias comereis pães asmos. Logo ao primeiro dia, tirareis das vossas casas o fermento, pois todo o que comer pão levedado desde o primeiro dia até o sétimo, será cortada de Israel aquela alma.

verses.original: וּבַיּ֤וֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ מִקְרָא־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִקְרָא־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ מְלָאכָה֙ לֹא־ יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם אַ֚ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֣ל לְכָל־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ ה֥וּא לְבַדּ֖וֹ יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm hā·ri·šō·wn miq·rā- qō·ḏeš ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î miq·rā- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh lō- yê·‘ā·śeh ḇā·hem ’aḵ ’ă·šer yê·’ā·ḵêl lə·ḵāl ne·p̄eš hū lə·ḇad·dōw yê·‘ā·śeh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: On the first day you are to hold a sacred assembly and another . . . on the seventh day You must not do any work on those days except to prepare the meals - that is all you may do
verses.literalPt: Ao primeiro dia, haverá para vós uma santa convocação; e, ao sétimo dia, uma santa convocação; nestes dias, não se fará nenhuma espécie de trabalho, exceto o que diz respeito ao comer; somente isso poderá ser feito por vós.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֮ אֶת־ הַמַּצּוֹת֒ כִּ֗י בְּעֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶת־ צִבְאוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֖ם חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ kî bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ- ṣiḇ·’ō·w·ṯê·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: So you are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread for on this very day I brought your divisions out of the land of Egypt You must keep this day as a permanent statute for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: Guardareis a festa dos pães asmos, porque nesse mesmo dia fiz sair os vossos exércitos da terra do Egito; portanto, observareis este dia de geração em geração por estatuto perpétuo.

verses.original: בָּרִאשֹׁ֡ן בְּאַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֤וֹם לַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב תֹּאכְל֖וּ מַצֹּ֑ת עַ֠ד י֣וֹם הָאֶחָ֧ד וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ בָּעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ri·šōn bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·‘e·reḇ tō·ḵə·lū maṣ·ṣōṯ ‘aḏ yō·wm hā·’e·ḥāḏ wə·‘eś·rîm la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: In the first month you are to eat unleavened bread from the evening of the fourteenth . . . day . . . until the evening of the twenty-first . . . . . . day
verses.literalPt: No primeiro mês, aos quatorze dias do mês, à tarde, comereis pães asmos, até os vinte e um dias do mês à tarde.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים שְׂאֹ֕ר לֹ֥א יִמָּצֵ֖א בְּבָתֵּיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י׀ כָּל־ אֹכֵ֣ל מַחְמֶ֗צֶת וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה הַנֶּ֤פֶשׁ הַהִוא֙ מֵעֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּגֵּ֖ר וּבְאֶזְרַ֥ח הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm śə·’ōr lō yim·mā·ṣê bə·ḇāt·tê·ḵem kî kāl- ’ō·ḵêl maḥ·me·ṣeṯ wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mê·‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl bag·gêr ū·ḇə·’ez·raḥ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For seven days there must be no leaven found in your houses If anyone eats something leavened that person whether a foreigner or native of the land must be cut off from the congregation of Israel
verses.literalPt: Por sete dias, não se achará fermento nas vossas casas; pois todo o que comer pão levedado será cortado da congregação de Israel, quer seja ele peregrino, quer seja natural da terra.

verses.original: כָּל־ מַחְמֶ֖צֶת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ בְּכֹל֙ מוֹשְׁבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תֹּאכְל֖וּ מַצּֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- maḥ·me·ṣeṯ lō ṯō·ḵê·lū bə·ḵōl mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem tō·ḵə·lū maṣ·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: You are not to eat anything leavened eat unleavened bread in all your homes
verses.literalPt: Nenhuma coisa levedada comereis; em todas as vossas habitações, comereis pães asmos.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה לְכָל־ זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם מִֽשְׁכ֗וּ וּקְח֨וּ לָכֶ֥ם צֹ֛אן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיכֶ֖ם וְשַׁחֲט֥וּ הַפָּֽסַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā mō·šeh lə·ḵāl ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem miš·ḵū ū·qə·ḥū lā·ḵem ṣōn lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯê·ḵem wə·ša·ḥă·ṭū hap·pā·saḥ
verses.literal: Then Moses summoned all the elders of Israel and told them Go at once and select for yourselves a lamb for each family and slaughter the Passover lamb
verses.literalPt: Chamou Moisés todos os anciãos de Israel e disse-lhes: Tirai do rebanho e tomai-vos cordeiros segundo as vossas famílias e matai a Páscoa.

verses.original: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֞ם אֲגֻדַּ֣ת אֵז֗וֹב וּטְבַלְתֶּם֮ בַּדָּ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־ בַּסַּף֒ וְהִגַּעְתֶּ֤ם אֶל־ הַמַּשְׁקוֹף֙ וְאֶל־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַמְּזוּזֹ֔ת מִן־ הַדָּ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסָּ֑ף וְאַתֶּ֗ם לֹ֥א תֵצְא֛וּ אִ֥ישׁ מִפֶּֽתַח־ בֵּית֖וֹ עַד־ בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·qaḥ·tem ’ă·ḡud·daṯ ’ê·zō·wḇ ū·ṭə·ḇal·tem bad·dām ’ă·šer- bas·sap̄ wə·hig·ga‘·tem ’el- ham·maš·qō·wp̄ wə·’el- šə·tê ham·mə·zū·zōṯ min- had·dām ’ă·šer bas·sāp̄ wə·’at·tem lō ṯê·ṣə·’ū ’îš mip·pe·ṯaḥ- bê·ṯōw ‘aḏ- bō·qer
verses.literal: Take a cluster of hyssop dip it into the blood in the basin and brush the blood - on the top and sides of the doorframe None . . . of you shall go out the door of his house until morning
verses.literalPt: Tomareis um molho de hissopo, ensopá-lo-eis no sangue que estiver na bacia, e marcareis a verga e as duas ombreiras com o sangue que estiver na bacia. Nenhum de vós sairá da porta da sua casa até pela manhã.

verses.original: וְעָבַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לִנְגֹּ֣ף אֶת־ מִצְרַיִם֒ וְרָאָ֤ה אֶת־ הַדָּם֙ עַל־ הַמַּשְׁק֔וֹף וְעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֣י הַמְּזוּזֹ֑ת וּפָסַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ עַל־ הַפֶּ֔תַח וְלֹ֤א יִתֵּן֙ הַמַּשְׁחִ֔ית לָבֹ֥א אֶל־ בָּתֵּיכֶ֖ם לִנְגֹּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar Yah·weh lin·gōp̄ ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim wə·rā·’āh ’eṯ- had·dām ‘al- ham·maš·qō·wp̄ wə·‘al šə·tê ham·mə·zū·zōṯ ū·p̄ā·saḥ Yah·weh ‘al- hap·pe·ṯaḥ wə·lō yit·tên ham·maš·ḥîṯ lā·ḇō ’el- bāt·tê·ḵem lin·gōp̄
verses.literal: When the LORD passes through to strike down the Egyptians He will see the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe and will pass over that doorway so He will not allow the destroyer to enter . . . your houses and strike you down
verses.literalPt: Pois Jeová passará para ferir os egípcios; quando vir o sangue sobre a verga e sobre as duas ombreiras, passará Jeová por aquela casa e não permitirá entrar o Destruidor nas vossas casas para vos ferir.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה לְחָק־ לְךָ֥ וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh lə·ḥāq- lə·ḵā ū·lə·ḇā·ne·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: And you are to keep this command as a permanent statute for you and your descendants
verses.literalPt: Guardareis isso por estatuto para vós e para vossos filhos, para sempre.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּֽי־ תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- ṯā·ḇō·’ū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer yit·tên Yah·weh lā·ḵem ka·’ă·šer dib·bêr ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: When you enter . . . the land that the LORD will give you as He promised you are to keep this service
verses.literalPt: Quando tiverdes entrado na terra que Jeová vos há de dar, como tem prometido, observareis esse serviço.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֕ה כִּֽי־ יֹאמְר֥וּ אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּנֵיכֶ֑ם מָ֛ה הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- yō·mə·rū ’ă·lê·ḵem bə·nê·ḵem māh hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh haz·zōṯ lā·ḵem
verses.literal: When your children ask you . . . What does this service mean to you
verses.literalPt: Quando vossos filhos vos perguntarem: Que quereis dizer com este rito?

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֡ם זֶֽבַח־ פֶּ֨סַח ה֜וּא לַֽיהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּ֠סַח עַל־ בָּתֵּ֤י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם בְּנָגְפּ֥וֹ אֶת־ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ בָּתֵּ֣ינוּ הִצִּ֑יל וַיִּקֹּ֥ד הָעָ֖ם וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar·tem ze·ḇaḥ- pe·saḥ hū Yah·weh ’ă·šer pā·saḥ ‘al- bāt·tê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·miṣ·ra·yim bə·nā·ḡə·pōw ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim wə·’eṯ- bāt·tê·nū hiṣ·ṣîl way·yiq·qōḏ hā·‘ām way·yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū
verses.literal: you are to reply It is the Passover sacrifice to the LORD who passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt when He struck down - the Egyptians and spared our homes Then the people bowed down and worshiped
verses.literalPt: Respondereis: É o sacrifício da Páscoa de Jeová, que passou as casas dos filhos de Israel no Egito, quando feriu aos egípcios e livrou as nossas casas. Então, o povo, prostrando-se por terra, adorou.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū way·ya·‘ă·śū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn kên ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: And the Israelites . . . went and did just what the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron
verses.literalPt: Foram-se os filhos de Israel e assim fizeram; como Jeová ordenara a Moisés e a Arão, assim fizeram.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּחֲצִ֣י הַלַּ֗יְלָה וַֽיהוָה֮ הִכָּ֣ה כָל־ בְּכוֹר֮ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ מִבְּכֹ֤ר פַּרְעֹה֙ הַיֹּשֵׁ֣ב עַל־ כִּסְא֔וֹ עַ֚ד בְּכ֣וֹר הַשְּׁבִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית הַבּ֑וֹר וְכֹ֖ל בְּכ֥וֹר בְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ba·ḥă·ṣî hal·lay·lāh Yah·weh hik·kāh ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mib·bə·ḵōr par·‘ōh hay·yō·šêḇ ‘al- kis·’ōw ‘aḏ bə·ḵō·wr haš·šə·ḇî ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ hab·bō·wr wə·ḵōl bə·ḵō·wr bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: Now at midnight . . . the LORD struck down every firstborn male in the land of Egypt from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon . . . as well as all the firstborn among the livestock
verses.literalPt: Aconteceu que, à meia-noite, feriu Jeová a todos os primogênitos na terra do Egito, desde o primogênito de Faraó, que se assentava no seu trono, até o primogênito do cativo que estava na enxovia; e todos os primogênitos dos animais.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קָם פַּרְעֹ֜ה לַ֗יְלָה ה֤וּא וְכָל־ עֲבָדָיו֙ וְכָל־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַתְּהִ֛י צְעָקָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־ אֵ֣ין בַּ֔יִת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־ שָׁ֖ם מֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām par·‘ōh lay·lāh hū wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·ḵāl miṣ·ra·yim wat·tə·hî ṣə·‘ā·qāh ḡə·ḏō·lāh bə·miṣ·rā·yim kî- ’ên ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer ’ên- šām mêṯ
verses.literal: During the night Pharaoh got up he and all his officials and all . . . the Egyptians and there was loud wailing in Egypt for there was no house without . . . someone dead
verses.literalPt: Levantou-se Faraó de noite, ele, todos os seus servos e todos os egípcios; e fez-se um grande clamor no Egito, pois não havia casa sem algum morto.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָא֩ לְמֹשֶׁ֨ה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹ֜ן לַ֗יְלָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ ק֤וּמוּ צְּאוּ֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ עַמִּ֔י גַּם־ אַתֶּ֖ם גַּם־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּלְכ֛וּ עִבְד֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה כְּדַבֶּרְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā lə·mō·šeh ū·lə·’a·hă·rōn lay·lāh way·yō·mer qū·mū ṣə·’ū mit·tō·wḵ ‘am·mî gam- ’at·tem gam- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·lə·ḵū ‘iḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kə·ḏab·ber·ḵem
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron by night and said Get up leave . . . my people both you and the Israelites . . . Go worship the LORD as you have requested
verses.literalPt: Então, mandou chamar a Moisés e a Arão, de noite, e disse: Levantai-vos, saí do meio do meu povo, tanto vós como os filhos de Israel; ide, servi a Jeová como tendes dito.

verses.original: גַּם־ צֹאנְכֶ֨ם גַּם־ בְּקַרְכֶ֥ם קְח֛וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּרְתֶּ֖ם וָלֵ֑כוּ וּבֵֽרַכְתֶּ֖ם גַּם־ אֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ṣō·nə·ḵem gam- bə·qar·ḵem qə·ḥū ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tem wā·lê·ḵū ū·ḇê·raḵ·tem gam- ’ō·ṯî
verses.literal: Take your flocks and herds as well just as you have said and depart And bless me also
verses.literalPt: Levai convosco os vossos rebanhos e os vossos gados, como tendes dito, e ide-vos embora; abençoai-me também a mim.

verses.original: וַתֶּחֱזַ֤ק מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ עַל־ הָעָ֔ם לְמַהֵ֖ר לְשַׁלְּחָ֣ם מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י אָמְר֖וּ כֻּלָּ֥נוּ מֵתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·te·ḥĕ·zaq miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- hā·‘ām lə·ma·hêr lə·šal·lə·ḥām min- hā·’ā·reṣ kî ’ā·mə·rū kul·lā·nū mê·ṯîm
verses.literal: And in order to send them out of the land quickly the Egyptians . . . urged the people on For otherwise they said we are all going to die
verses.literalPt: Os egípcios apertavam o povo, para o lançarem fora da terra à pressa, pois diziam: Todos nós somos mortos.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א הָעָ֛ם אֶת־ בְּצֵק֖וֹ טֶ֣רֶם יֶחְמָ֑ץ מִשְׁאֲרֹתָ֛ם צְרֻרֹ֥ת בְּשִׂמְלֹתָ֖ם עַל־ שִׁכְמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā hā·‘ām ’eṯ- bə·ṣê·qōw ṭe·rem yeḥ·māṣ miš·’ă·rō·ṯām ṣə·ru·rōṯ bə·śim·lō·ṯām ‘al- šiḵ·mām
verses.literal: So the people took their dough before it was leavened carrying it on their shoulders in kneading bowls wrapped in clothing
verses.literalPt: O povo tomou a sua massa antes que fosse ela levedada, sendo as suas amassadeiras atadas em seus vestidos sobre os seus ombros.

verses.original: וּבְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עָשׂ֖וּ כִּדְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽיִּשְׁאֲלוּ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם כְּלֵי־ כֶ֛סֶף וּכְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּשְׂמָלֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·śū kiḏ·ḇar mō·šeh way·yiš·’ă·lū mim·miṣ·ra·yim kə·lê- ḵe·sep̄ ū·ḵə·lê zā·hāḇ ū·śə·mā·lōṯ
verses.literal: Furthermore, the Israelites . . . acted on Moses’ word and asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold and for clothing
verses.literalPt: Fizeram também os filhos de Israel segundo as palavras de Moisés: pediram aos egípcios joias de prata, e joias de ouro, e vestidos.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֞ה נָתַ֨ן אֶת־ חֵ֥ן הָעָ֛ם בְּעֵינֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם וַיַּשְׁאִל֑וּם וַֽיְנַצְּל֖וּ אֶת־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh nā·ṯan ’eṯ- ḥên hā·‘ām bə·‘ê·nê miṣ·ra·yim way·yaš·’i·lūm way·naṣ·ṣə·lū ’eṯ- miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And the LORD gave the people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that they granted their request In this way they plundered the Egyptians
verses.literalPt: Jeová deu ao povo graça aos olhos dos egípcios, de maneira que estes deram ao povo o que pedia. E despojaram aos egípcios.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵרַעְמְסֵ֖ס סֻכֹּ֑תָה כְּשֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֧לֶף רַגְלִ֛י הַגְּבָרִ֖ים לְבַ֥ד מִטָּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·ra‘·mə·sês suk·kō·ṯāh kə·šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ raḡ·lî hag·gə·ḇā·rîm lə·ḇaḏ miṭ·ṭāp̄
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . journeyed from Rameses to Succoth with about 600,000 . . . . . . men on foot besides women and children
verses.literalPt: Viajaram os filhos de Israel de Ramessés a Sucote, sendo perto de seiscentos mil homens de pé, sem contar as crianças.

verses.original: וְגַם־ עֵ֥רֶב רַ֖ב עָלָ֣ה אִתָּ֑ם וְצֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר מִקְנֶ֖ה כָּבֵ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ‘ê·reḇ raḇ ‘ā·lāh ’it·tām wə·ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār miq·neh kā·ḇêḏ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: And a mixed multitude also went up with them along with great droves of . . . livestock both flocks and herds
verses.literalPt: Subiu com eles uma grande mistura de gente; também rebanhos e gados, muitíssimas cabeças.

verses.original: וַיֹּאפ֨וּ אֶת־ הַבָּצֵ֜ק אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֧יאוּ מִמִּצְרַ֛יִם עֻגֹ֥ת מַצּ֖וֹת כִּ֣י לֹ֣א חָמֵ֑ץ כִּֽי־ גֹרְשׁ֣וּ מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וְלֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ לְהִתְמַהְמֵ֔הַּ וְגַם־ צֵדָ֖ה לֹא־ עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·p̄ū ’eṯ- hab·bā·ṣêq ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣî·’ū mim·miṣ·ra·yim ‘u·ḡōṯ maṣ·ṣō·wṯ kî lō ḥā·mêṣ kî- ḡō·rə·šū mim·miṣ·ra·yim wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū lə·hiṯ·mah·mê·ah wə·ḡam- ṣê·ḏāh lō- ‘ā·śū lā·hem
verses.literal: Since their dough had no leaven the people baked - what they had brought out of Egypt into unleavened loaves For when they had been driven out of Egypt they could not delay and had not prepared any provisions for themselves
verses.literalPt: Cozeram bolos asmos da massa que levaram do Egito; pois ela não se tinha levedado, porque foram lançados fora do Egito. Não puderam deter-se, nem haviam preparado para si alguma comida.

verses.original: וּמוֹשַׁב֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·wō·šaḇ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yā·šə·ḇū bə·miṣ·rā·yim šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh
verses.literal: Now the duration of the Israelites’ stay in Egypt was 430 . . . . . . . . . years
verses.literalPt: Ora, o tempo que os filhos de Israel moraram no Egito foi de quatrocentos e trinta anos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִקֵּץ֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיְהִ֗י בְּעֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה יָֽצְא֛וּ כָּל־ צִבְא֥וֹת יְהוָ֖ה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh way·hî bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh yā·ṣə·’ū kāl- ṣiḇ·’ō·wṯ Yah·weh mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: At the end of the 430 . . . . . . . . . . . . years to the very day all the LORD’s divisions went out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Ao fim dos quatrocentos e trinta anos, nesse mesmo dia, aconteceu que todos os exércitos de Jeová saíram da terra do Egito.

verses.original: לֵ֣יל שִׁמֻּרִ֥ים הוּא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לְהוֹצִיאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הֽוּא־ הַלַּ֤יְלָה הַזֶּה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁמֻּרִ֛ים לְכָל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: lêl šim·mu·rîm hū Yah·weh lə·hō·w·ṣî·’ām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim hū- hal·lay·lāh haz·zeh Yah·weh šim·mu·rîm lə·ḵāl bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām
verses.literal: Because the LORD kept a vigil that night to bring them out of the land of Egypt . . . this same night is to be a vigil to the LORD to be observed by all the Israelites . . . for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: É uma noite mui digna de se observar a Jeová, porque os tirou da terra do Egito; esta é aquela noite de Jeová, mui digna de se observar por todos os filhos de Israel nas suas gerações.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן זֹ֖את חֻקַּ֣ת הַפָּ֑סַח כָּל־ בֶּן־ נֵכָ֖ר לֹא־ יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn zōṯ ḥuq·qaṯ hap·pā·saḥ kāl- ben- nê·ḵār lō- yō·ḵal bōw
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron This is the statute of the Passover No . . . foreigner . . . is to eat of it
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés e a Arão: Esta é a ordenança da Páscoa: nenhum estrangeiro comerá dela;

verses.original: וְכָל־ עֶ֥בֶד אִ֖ישׁ מִקְנַת־ כָּ֑סֶף וּמַלְתָּ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ אָ֖ז יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ‘e·ḇeḏ ’îš miq·naṯ- kā·sep̄ ū·mal·tāh ’ō·ṯōw ’āz yō·ḵal bōw
verses.literal: But any slave who has been purchased . . . may eat of it after you have circumcised him
verses.literalPt: porém todo escravo comprado por dinheiro, depois que o tiveres circuncidado, comerá dela.

verses.original: תּוֹשָׁ֥ב וְשָׂכִ֖יר לֹא־ יֹ֥אכַל־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: tō·wō·šāḇ wə·śā·ḵîr lō- yō·ḵal- bōw
verses.literal: A temporary resident or hired hand shall not eat the Passover
verses.literalPt: O forasteiro e o mercenário não comerão dela.

verses.original: בְּבַ֤יִת אֶחָד֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹא־ תוֹצִ֧יא מִן־ הַבַּ֛יִת מִן־ הַבָּשָׂ֖ר ח֑וּצָה וְעֶ֖צֶם לֹ֥א תִשְׁבְּרוּ־ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḇa·yiṯ ’e·ḥāḏ yê·’ā·ḵêl lō- ṯō·w·ṣî min- hab·ba·yiṯ min- hab·bā·śār ḥū·ṣāh wə·‘e·ṣem lō ṯiš·bə·rū- ḇōw
verses.literal: It must be eaten inside one house You are not to take any of the meat outside . . . the house and you may not break any of the bones
verses.literalPt: O cordeiro há de ser comido numa só casa; da sua carne não levareis nada fora da casa, nem lhe quebrareis osso algum.

verses.original: כָּל־ עֲדַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יַעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl ya·‘ă·śū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: The whole congregation of Israel must celebrate it
verses.literalPt: Toda a congregação de Israel a observará.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יָג֨וּר אִתְּךָ֜ גֵּ֗ר וְעָ֣שָׂה פֶסַח֮ לַיהוָה֒ הִמּ֧וֹל ל֣וֹ כָל־ זָכָ֗ר וְאָז֙ יִקְרַ֣ב לַעֲשֹׂת֔וֹ וְהָיָ֖ה כְּאֶזְרַ֣ח הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכָל־ עָרֵ֖ל לֹֽא־ יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yā·ḡūr ’it·tə·ḵā gêr wə·‘ā·śāh p̄e·saḥ Yah·weh him·mō·wl lōw ḵāl zā·ḵār wə·’āz yiq·raḇ la·‘ă·śō·ṯōw wə·hā·yāh kə·’ez·raḥ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵāl ‘ā·rêl lō- yō·ḵal bōw
verses.literal: If a foreigner resides with you and wants to celebrate the LORD’s Passover all the males in the household must be circumcised then he may come near to celebrate it and he shall be like a native of the land . . . But no uncircumcised man may eat of it
verses.literalPt: Quando um estrangeiro peregrinar entre vós e quiser guardar a Páscoa a Jeová, circuncidem-se todos os seus machos; então, se chegará e a observará. Será como o natural da terra, porém nenhum incircunciso comerá dela.

verses.original: תּוֹרָ֣ה אַחַ֔ת יִהְיֶ֖ה לָֽאֶזְרָ֑ח וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·rāh ’a·ḥaṯ yih·yeh lā·’ez·rāḥ wə·lag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem
verses.literal: The same law shall apply to both the native and the foreigner who resides among you
verses.literalPt: Haverá uma mesma lei para o natural e o estrangeiro que peregrina entre vós.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh wə·’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn kên ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: Then all the Israelites . . . did this they did just as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron
verses.literalPt: Assim, fizeram todos os filhos de Israel; como Jeová ordenara a Moisés e a Arão, assim fizeram.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה הוֹצִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל־ צִבְאֹתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh hō·w·ṣî Yah·weh ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: And on that very day the LORD brought the Israelites . . . out of the land of Egypt by their divisions
verses.literalPt: Naquele mesmo dia, tirou Jeová os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito por suas turmas.
